Definition: adverb from G5446; "physically", i.e. (by implication) instinctively:--naturally.
BiblicalUsage: Physikos as an adverb means naturally, by instinct, like an animal. Jude uses it once, in Jude 1:10, of men who speak evil of what they do not know, and corrupt themselves in what they know naturally, as brute beasts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe living by instinct instead of by truth is what makes a man lower than the beast.
